Chaos Order is powerful demon introduced in Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena.

Is this order, or chaos...? Quite mysterious, yet quite intriguing...
Chaos Order

Personality

She is twisted and seeks to create disorder, but also has a shy and childish side. Although her intelligence was high from birth, commensurate with her appearance, she has almost no knowledge or common sense.

Self-proclaimed, she is an existence that seeks calamity and discord. Chaos Order can act smug and pompous, she is strongly insulted by the idea of being a failed experiment. She has by pure chance performed revenge for her creator without knowing it. Apart from her lack of ethics, she is like a young woman, laughing when she is happy, crying when she is sad and bright-eyed when she is interested. If there is the right opportunity, there may be a possibility that her perception of chaos might change. She is also attracted to anything that finds disorder and chaos, not just human death, and some people have been saved by her accidental interest.

Appearance
She has red eyes, dark skin and white hair.

History
Background
Chaos Order, is a chaos-seeking, dark matter being, created by an alchemist that researched dark matter. She was considered a failed experiment at first, but the alchemist still tried to educate her beyond seeking just chaos.

However, the alchemist lost the opportunity when they were attacked and killed by another alchemist who was after their research results. Enjoying the chaos of the situation, Chaos Order started to kill herself without any plan, killing her creator's murderer. Afterward, she was free and escaped into the wild.

As an incarnation of high-energy dark matter, no one can stop her, and she becomes what she calls a "walking disaster", wreaking death without realizing how bad it is but also helps people at times.

Timeline TABA
She appears first to Fuuma Saika, that had been captured by Gosha at the time, and wishes to free her as she senses Chaos and ambition within her. Saika refuses the call of action, but Chaos Order does not mind, as she teleports out of the room. As other Taimanin arrive, they notice the broken jail, and assume Saika does try to escape, which forces Saika to defend herself and in the end escape after all. Chaos Order is after this not seen in other story events.

Attracted by the chaos in Fuuma Kotaro (TABA)'s body in a "what if", she tries to free it and create more disorder by attacking his Fuuma Organization.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Magic

Dark Matter Magic: The object touching her the right hand and the object touching the left hand are mixed together on a molecular level and transformed into a single object. Depending on how she uses it, she may be able to create useful substances, but she only uses it to bring chaos to the world.
